bucket_note: Open, record-level, statewide CSV zips by county and year (2006-2025), PennDOT GPS on 99.5-99.9%, street names on 99.5-99.96%, crash-level KABCO plus person/vehicle tables. Catches: no published reuse licence; the day of the month is withheld.

sources.name: PennDOT public crash data (PennDOT GIS Open Data, Crash Data Download map)
sources.licence_text: No licence published. PennDOT Open Data: 'all of our published GIS data that you can map, style, chart, download or share'. Data dictionary: 'Data that is protected due to containing Personally Identifiable Information, or that could be used to infer information about persons involved in a crash are not included in the public dataset.' DVRPC's catalog copy: 'License: No License Provided'.
sources.kabco: yes: crash MAX_SEVERITY_LEVEL 1-4 = K/A/B/C, 0 = O; 8 (injury, unknown severity) and 9 (unknown if injured) -> U; person-level injury in PERSON (not read yet)

placement_sample.auto_share_note: 0 under the default Gate: every placement on a TIGER-only network is a suggestion unless config sets tiger_only_auto. With tiger_only_auto: Philadelphia 91.5%, Allegheny 67.5%
placement_sample.note: accuracy = auto-placeable (exact/unique_pair) with tiger_only_auto, against PennDOT's hidden GPS; the reader's spelled-ordinal fix (SIXTYTHIRD ST -> 63RD ST) raised Philadelphia's name-placed share from 67.8% to 92.7%. PennDOT gives no house numbers.

end_to_end.corridor: North Broad Street, Girard Ave to Susquehanna Ave, Philadelphia
end_to_end.crash_cost_note: K/A/B/C/O at PennDOT Crash Facts 2025 costs; the 102 U crashes unpriced

blockers: no published reuse licence for a paid product
the public files have no day of the month (month, weekday and hour only)
statewide average crash rates are given by PennDOT HSTOD on request only
